AMZN.rationale: Amazon presents a solid fundamental case with strong trajectory. Q3 2025 showed accelerating revenue ($180.2B, +7.4% QoQ) and EPS growth ($1.95, +16.1% QoQ), with Q1 2026 results even stronger at $181.5B revenue (+17% YoY) and record 13.1% operating margin. AWS is reaccelerating at 28% growth, advertising is growing 24%, and the North America segment is showing durable operating leverage. The balance sheet is healthy with $369.6B equity and modest 0.15 debt-to-equity. However, the stock trades at a P/E of 34.2x, which is mid-range within its 28-39x 12-month window—neither cheap nor expensive versus its own history. The massive $200B 2026 capex plan has crushed free cash flow (down 95% YoY in Q1 2026 to $1.2B), creating real near-term uncertainty about capital returns. Regulatory headwinds are material: FTC antitrust trial set for October 2026, EU DMA/DSA compliance costs, and rising global scrutiny. The Blue Origin rocket explosion delays Project Kuiper, a modest negative. News sentiment is moderately positive (mean 0.36 over 90 days). No clear near-term re-rating catalyst ahead of the July 30 earnings report, though Wall Street consensus targets $320+ with expectations of 8.3% EPS growth and 16.8% revenue growth. The score reflects a high-quality franchise with strong growth trajectory, offset by fair-to-slightly-rich valuation, massive capex uncertainty, and regulatory overhang.
